statements.S1: T_real is a statistic of the joint rooted path multiset (Q,K,Z are per-path functions of (a_v,b_e1,a_w,b_e2,a_u)); no information beyond the graph + frozen encoders is created.
statements.S2: sum_paths(q*k*z) ≡ sum_w q(v,w) ⊙ sum_u(k(w,u)*z(u)): flat and branch-first forms are the same function (float64 roundoff only).
statements.S3: content_agg is a rank-≤96 linear map of the (path-cat × endpoint-content) matrix, so within-cell re-pairings are invisible to X_v by construction; the demo realises one with T_max_abs_diff > 0.
statements.S4: X_v is therefore a non-injective compression of the path-content configuration. No claim is made that the same kernel is realised by two distinct ZINC molecules; realised irrecoverability is measured empirically.
